{{Quote|Outpost Four-two-seven, this is Major Artano, information control specialist for General Rakton's command group.|Artano|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Artano''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He served as an information control specialist for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton|Rakton's]] command group. On [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], he tried to stop [[Havoc Squad]] from reassembling the [[Black cipher|umbra encrypter]], but was defeated and killed in combat.
